verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 / DGX B200 is GPU compute hardware with management and monitoring software. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is a workflow-platform capability, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any automation versioning or rollback feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
